reviews.classification: bounded source depth, inherited gaps and rough owner routing qualified
reviews.disposition:
F1: Complete map review covers all 320 entries, the header, all dictionaries and 18 routing blocks through the [lossless reading view](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/academagia-family-lossless-view-b594.json). The [round-trip receipt](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/academagia-family-view-receipt-b594.json) reconstructs every original field exactly. The 9600-line JSON and its schema remain unchanged. Build 2453605 and selected source traces remain historical evidence, not a refreshed installation, raw-body reread or gameplay result.

F2: The 61 systems, 57 namespaces, 112 tables, 50 UI namespaces, 16 DLL rows and 24 inherited gaps deliberately overlap. Their status totals are 57 prior-bounded, 42 deep-bounded, 56 inventoried-only, 106 module-partial, 17 dependency-unread, 18 zero-row, 17 open-prior, six partly-closed and one source-closed. Registration and root_save_order identify a source arrangement, not complete serialization: registered AbilitySystem and ActionSystem still have different context-saving paths, while unregistered helpers may serve real consumers. Namespace type/file signals differ for some rows and include generated or wrapper types; do not sum them as independent mechanics. The broad authoring/save routing of Study, Visit, Clazz, Clock and UI controls, npc_ai routing of PrivateImplementationDetails, or presentation routing of Familar/Relations is navigation rather than an adjudicated purpose or complete source read.

F3: Preserve the three separate static base, Content and Summer reconstructions. They are not additive totals, a combined ordered profile, or evidence of the user's selected patch/cache. Summer has fewer SkillLevelThreshold, SkillPerk and Topic rows than Content in these separate profiles; do not silently turn the no-deletion reconstruction label into a claim that every profile monotonically contains every other profile's rows. The recorded string[] versus List<Guid> deletion interpretation remains an unresolved runtime question. Zero rows in AIGoal, Clique, Player, PersistEntityRef, Article and related tables do not establish absent AI, relationships, creation, persistence or newspapers; named system paths and authored graphs need their own consumers. Conversely NewspaperIssue's 20 rows do not prove delivered articles. A recipe/item count match, BreedType/FamiliarType label or Region table does not establish reachable production, reproduction/genetics or cross-world travel.

F4: Retain useful bounded proposals with their actual limits: material plus finishing choices need a downstream use; companion expertise needs a named contributor and solo alternative where fitting; backgrounds should grant real means rather than ancestry proof; paid orders separate payment, saved arrival and usable custody. Gift preference, accepted custody and remembered incident are distinct. Emotion entry/effect/exit and weather or celestial forecasts need real activity consequences; none becomes a universal cap, once rule or new mandatory framework. Existing broad palettes remain their homes. A dedicated authored team-sport or celestial-cycle contract was not found in the checked palettes; this is a bounded exact-owner gap, not an exhaustive absence or implementation mandate.

F5: Review preserves all 24 inherited gap dispositions individually. DS12 closes the authored Declare Vendetta selector versus direct method distinction, not full duel math; DS13/MERIT_MATRIX closes the shared award algorithm and static college-gate census, not the special +12 relationship effect. DS01/02/05/07/10/12/13 narrow the old bundled formulas gap without closing combat/duel/Rimbal. DS03/04 source paths for familiar/creation do not close native creation UI or adopt the old half-Bond claim. The source merge algorithm does not prove the selected runtime cache; the two named club mechanical graphs do not prove every other society or native reachability. Fifteen bounded flows do not close every named system, table or helper.

F6: Still open are per-line speaker attribution and rumor generation; native layout, keyboard/accessibility and creation flow; complete save migration/corrupt recovery; newspaper delivery; dynamic resolver/expression/dependency semantics; non-club scene intentions and other-named groups; the 258-page wiki crosswalk; combined Content+Summer order; live cache/profile and gameplay; editor availability; full combat and special relationship effects. Prior mechanical exhaustiveness is attributed to its recorded structural scope, never every narrative meaning or possible binding. Source/static/source-closed statuses do not establish YAIRPG adoption, built browser behavior, persistence or human review. Current PROJECT retires the old first-milestone gate; these ideas do not reinstate it or displace the current build sequence. This reconciliation performs no acquisition, native launch, private-state access, source change, migration, runtime test, deletion, move, commit or push.
reviews.evidence: All 320 residual records read in bounded outputs, plus complete header/dictionaries/18 routing blocks; exact JSON reconstruction and source SHA in academagia-family-view-receipt-b594.json.
reviews.reopen: Use the actual selected producer/consumer and profile for any future source or behavior claim; retain all 24 parent gaps and unreviewed raw bodies.
